samar: quick snapshot from the evening run — A100 vs H100 across 3 regions (us-east1 / europe-west1 / asia-southeast1). ran prefill+decode for Llama-like 7B and 13B variants, q8x4 where supported, cutlass vs tensorkernel sweeps. putting the concise table below, pls poke holes. :mag_right:

samar: ```
model,gpu,region,p50_prefill_ms,p50_decode_ms,tokens_per_sec,$_per_1M_tokens,quant,fast_kernel
7b,a100,us-east1,120,18,1400,12.5,q8x4,cutlass
7b,h100,us-east1,95,12,2100,9.1,q8x4,tensorkernel
13b,a100,us-east1,220,34,780,20.1,int8,cutlass
13b,h100,us-east1,180,22,1200,14.8,int8,tensorkernel
7b,a100,europe-west1,140,22,1300,13.5,q8x4,cutlass
7b,h100,europe-west1,110,14,2000,9.8,q8x4,tensorkernel
7b,a100,asia-southeast1,240,40,900,18.9,q8x4,cutlass
7b,h100,asia-southeast1,190,28,1500,12.6,q8x4,tensorkernel
```

samar: high level notes — H100 consistently wins decode throughput (~1.5–1.8x) and lower decode p50. prefill delta depends a lot on region; APAC prefill p50 on A100 hit ~2x due to PCIe host->gpu hop + kernel latency. cost per 1M tokens is still a function of instance SKU pricing + effective tokens/sec — H100 lowers $/1M in most cases despite higher hourly price because of throughput.

june: nice. what were the seq lengths / batch config? did you include KV cache warmup in prefill numbers?

samar: seq len 512 for prefill runs, decode measured on 256 decode length (prompt+gen semantics we use). batch size single-request (we're measuring p50 single-stream latency). prefill includes KV cache populate from the 512 context (so it’s realistic for long-context use).

alex: were these runs on fixed kernel selection or did runtime fallback happen? i.e., was tensorkernel pinned or did the runtime switch to cutlass for parts of the run?

samar: we pinned kernel with env flags for the sweep: 
```bash
REDWOOD_KERNEL_PREFERENCE=tensorkernel 
REDWOOD_FORCE_QUANT_PROFILE=q8x4
./bench_runner --model-path /models/llama-7b --seq 512 --decode 256 --single-stream
```
we also ran an unpinned pass to validate runtime fallbacks — saw fallback to cutlass on some a100 driver combos for 13b int8 which explains sporadic p95 spikes.

rachel: APAC numbers stand out. is that infra-level NIC/placement noise (cross-rack) or an instance SKU mismatch?

samar: looked into it — two contributors: (1) our APAC host images on A100 were older drivers, causing slower nvlink utilization for multi-socket h2 instances, (2) placement sometimes ended up cross-rack for the prefill giant tensors. patching driver + forcing single-rack pinned placement reduced prefill p50 by ~20% on A100 there.

infra-bot: note — cluster-autoscaler created h100 pool in us-east1 for this run at 2026-03-19T18:02:11Z (id: pool-ml-h100-us).

june: good to know. any quality diffs after q8x4 on 13B? we care if cost wins but quality regresses on some eval prompts.

samar: quick eval on our small eval set (100 prompts) — 13B int8 had ~0.8% BLEU-ish metric drop and a handful of hallucination regressions on numeric reasoning prompts. 7B q8x4 looks clean. i'll paste the rough eval delta below:
```
metric,13b_fp16,13b_int8_delta,7b_fp16,7b_q8x4_delta
answer_accuracy,0.742,-0.008,0.691,-0.002
coherence,0.89,-0.01,0.86,-0.001
```
samar: so tradeoffs: 13B int8 saves ~25–30% $/1M vs fp16 on A100 but introduces a small quality hit; H100 int8 path is cheaper and slightly less regressive (we saw ~0.5% drop).

alex: for production SLOs i'd want p95 tail numbers too — p50 is great but tail matters for user latency. did you capture p95?

samar: yep. quick p95 notes: 7b_p95_decode a100 ~38ms, h100 ~24ms. 13b_p95_decode a100 ~68ms, h100 ~42ms. p95 prefills are more variable in APAC (A100 p95 up to 420ms vs H100 280ms) — likely still placement+driver.

rachel: suggestion — run a short canary with H100 tensorkernel + q8x4 for 7b in europe + us east for a week, capture real traffic mix. if quality/latency hold, we can flip routing policy for low-latency tiers.

samar: agreed. i'll spin the canary and post the canary run link. also adding a follow-up ticket to upgrade APAC A100 images and force single-rack placement when prefill-heavy.

telemetry-bot: canary created: /canaries/2802468000-h100-7b-q8x4 (expires 2026-03-26). alloc: 4x h100, regions: us-east1,europe-west1.

june: perfect. thanks samar — this is a useful concise snapshot. :thumbsup:
